quest.name: Big Fish in a Small Pond
quest.gameName: Daily: Big Fish in a Small Pond
quest.description: Grab a rod and scour Appalachia's waters for fish!

meta.note: One ammo type, set by your region.

pools.note: Handed out every single time you complete the daily.

pools.title: Curved Fish Display
pools.note: A CAMP display plaque. Drops at 100% until you learn it, then it leaves the pool.

pools.title: Regional Weapon Mod
pools.note: One random Yellow-Box weapon mod from the region Captain Raymond sent you to. You always receive exactly one.

pools.title: Fishing Hook Mod Plans
pools.note: The five hook upgrades. The pool only fires 20% of the time, and when it does it picks one plan — so each plan is ~4% per hand-in. Each plan stops dropping once you have learnt it.

relatedGuide.label: Reel Talk: Rod Mods, Hooks & Reels

items.name: Plan: Attractive Hook
conditions: Won't drop if you've already learned this plan

items.name: Plan: Improved Bearing
conditions: Won't drop if you've already learned this plan

items.name: Plan: Advanced Drag
conditions: Won't drop if you've already learned this plan

items.name: Plan: Stabilized Gear Ratio
conditions: Won't drop if you've already learned this plan

items.name: Plan: Steady Handle
conditions: Won't drop if you've already learned this plan

pools.title: CAMP & Recipe Plans
pools.note: Drops every hand-in and KEEPS dropping even after they are learnt — perfect for collecting duplicates to trade or gift.

pools.title: Contextual Aid & Ammo
pools.note: Aid and ammo set by the region the daily sends you to. In most regions you get one aid item and one ammo type; Savage Divide's aid list is flagged UseAll in-game, so there you get the whole aid set.

blurbLegend.desc: Guaranteed every time you hand the daily in.
Removed from the reward pool for that character once you have learnt the plan.
Continues to drop even after you have learnt it, so you can stockpile duplicates.
Can be traded to other players.
Can be dropped from your inventory (e.g. to gift to a new player).
How often this reward group appears at all on a hand-in.
The chance of a specific item within the group, factoring the pool chance in.
